turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. Could you send your order number and the email you used at checkout? I’ll check what options are available.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

I’m sorry your print went to your old flat. The delivery address can only be changed before an order ships, so I haven’t changed it. I’ve passed this to a colleague who will take over and review what options are still available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified with cressida.paunelu@example.com. Customer reports print delivered to old flat and requests Lindenweg 9, Graz. Policy blocks address change after shipping; no change filed. Please review what options remain.
